content.short: KakaoBank is a leading South Korean internet-only bank offering accounts, cards, loans and high-yield savings.
content.description: KakaoBank is one of South Korea's largest and fastest-growing digital banks, launched in 2017 by the group behind the KakaoTalk messaging app. Operating entirely through its mobile app, it offers deposit and checking accounts, debit and credit cards, personal loans, high-yield savings and popular social features like group accounts and character-branded design that helped it win tens of millions of customers. KakaoBank uses the reach of the Kakao ecosystem to deliver low-fee, easy-to-use banking to a broad consumer base, from students to families. As a fully licensed internet-only bank, it competes directly with traditional Korean banks.
